name: Incident response plans SHOULD be tested on an annual basis to ensure people are familiar with the process under pressure.
requirementTitle: Incident response plans SHOULD be tested on an annual basis to ensure people are familiar with the process under pressure.
requirementDescription: Service teams should practise responding to security incidents at least once a year so that, if a real incident occurs, people know what to do and can respond quickly and effectively
why: People discover during a real incident that contact lists are out of date, nobody knows who owns the service, escalation paths are unclear and people have never read the plan,. Testing helps identify those issues before a real emergency
tasks: Incident response plans SHOULD be tested on an annual basis to ensure people are familiar with the process under pressure.

actions.title: Incident response plans SHOULD be tested on an annual basis to ensure people are familiar with the process under pressure.
actions.description: Don't wait for a real cyber incident to discover whether your response process works. Practise it at least annually so that the people involved know their roles and can respond confidently when under pressure.
